description: Checks Experience-Expertise-Authoritativeness-Trustworthiness (E-E-A-T) signals on a page: byline/author, publish/modified dates, source citations (external links), links to an About/Methodology page, and legal-notice/privacy links. These signals matter for YMYL topics and for AI engines assessing whether to trust and cite a source.

url.description: Full URL of the page to check.

name: check_eeat_signals
